info.title: IELTS Practice API
info.description: Speaking + Writing practice API. Auth: Better Auth at /api/auth/* (cookie for web, `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for iOS — token returned in the `set-auth-token` header on sign-in).

isAnonymous.description: A guest (anonymous session, no account yet): show "Create an account", hide keys, history and review

isOwner.description: The site owner: shows the Admin area

gptLiveAvailable.description: This user has an OpenAI key (or is the owner)

realtimeAvailable.description: Deprecated alias of gptLiveAvailable (app versions from before GPT-Live)

geminiLiveAvailable.description: This user has a Gemini key (or is the owner)

liveProviders.description: Live examiner providers this user may use (their own keys; the owner may use the server keys)

resetAt.description: ISO instant the window resets; show in local time. null when unlimited

window.description: day: resets 00:00 UTC; week: resets Monday 00:00 UTC

blocked.description: Why a test cannot start now; null = it can

limit.description: USD spend limit of the shared OpenRouter key; null if it has none

used.description: USD spent so far; null if unknown

remaining.description: USD left; null if unknown or unlimited

updatedAt.description: ISO time of the reading (cached up to 60 s)

voices.description: TTS voices the model supports (empty for non-speech models)

done.description: The user has an attempt on this prompt

audio.description: Generated speaking prompts (single-prompt and test endpoints): presigned examiner audio. intro = greeting before the first Part 1 topic of a full test; lead = Let's talk about… / part transition; questions align with followUps (P2: the cue card title). A line without url is not rendered: ask it silently.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT (speaking). Send the same Content-Type as audioContentType.

resetAt.description: quota_exceeded: ISO time the window resets (00:00 UTC daily, Monday 00:00 UTC weekly)

CodedError.description: Errors with a machine-readable code (docs/community.md). Map `code` to UX; `error` is a fallback.

mockId.description: Full mock test: the attempt belongs to this open mock of the caller; sessionId must be the mock's writing/speaking session

audioContentType.description: Speaking only: audio/webm | audio/mp4 | audio/m4a | audio/wav (codec params allowed). Default audio/webm.

durationMs.description: Speaking: recording length. Writing: time spent in the editor (counts toward weekly minutes).

segments.description: Non-live speaking: answer window of each question (ms within the recording). Time between windows is app timing (page render, examiner audio) and is left out of the pause measurements.

conversationUrl.description: Live duplex: the whole conversation (candidate and examiner) for playback

retryable.description: status failed: false when retrying now cannot help (AI credit/key problem); show "try later" instead of Retry

stage.description: While analyzing: the pipeline step now running. writing: feedback → scoring (feedback is ready in `partial`) → finalizing; speaking: transcribing → analyzing → finalizing. null once done|failed or before the first step.

partial.description: Writing, while stage is scoring: the feedback that is ready before the scores (errors, structure, top fixes, vocab upgrades, rewrite, text metrics: AnalysisResult fields without criteria/overall). null otherwise.

models.description: Models that produced the analysis, by role (stt, analysis); null until done

topFixesInDeck.description: Every top fix is already in the review deck (as POST /api/cards/bulk with source 'fix' adds them)

audioUrl.description: Examiner TTS; null when the voice failed or was skipped: show examinerText as a caption and start listening

phase.description: Phase of this line; 'done' after the closing line

prepSeconds.description: p2-prep: seconds of preparation left; POST /turn (skipped) when it ends

mockId.description: Full mock test: use the mock's Cambridge test (ref) and require its speaking mode to be live

skipTts.description: Duplex (GPT-Live, Gemini Live) sessions speak for themselves: create the session without examiner TTS (audioUrl null)

sdp.description: The browser's SDP offer (data channel "oai-events" created before the offer)

GeminiLiveUsage.description: Running totals: each report replaces the previous one

parts.description: The parts not already sent with /live/part (may be empty)

marks.description: Question start offsets (ms) within this part

conversationKey.description: Upload key of the whole conversation (the candidate's mic mixed with the examiner's voice), for playback

question.description: The examiner line this window answers, as the examiner said it

segments.description: Answer windows in the recording clock: the recorder paused while the examiner was audible, so the gaps between windows are examiner time, not pauses

skill.description: The skill the criterion was judged in (Speaking and Writing share lr / gra keys)

weakest.description: Lowest criterion in recent work: the latest full test when the latest attempt is part of one, else the last 5 assessed attempts of that skill

predicted.description: roundBand of the mean of the last 5 overalls per skill (ignores the skill filter)

lastFailed.description: The user's most recent submitted attempt, when its analysis failed

inDeck.description: Already added to the review deck

liveProviders.description: Live examiner providers this user may use (their own keys; the owner may use the server keys)

valid.description: false: the provider rejected this key; enter a new one

ApiKeyInfo.description: The key itself is never returned.

total.description: Questions in the in-progress attempt (only its parts), else 40

attemptId.description: The in-progress attempt, when there is one

parts.description: Parts of the in-progress attempt (null = whole test or none)

answered.description: Answered questions in the in-progress attempt

bestBand.description: Best band of a whole-test attempt (partial attempts have no band)

parts.description: Chosen parts (listening 1–4, reading passages 1–3); null = the whole test. Partial attempts are scored raw/total with no band.

band.description: Null while in progress and for partial attempts

assets.description: Asset key → presigned GET URL (audio supports Range)

pos.description: Practice listening: saved playback position (seconds) per part

LrStats.description: Runner pacing: seconds per part, answer changes per question, questions answered in the final 5 minutes; audio = practice playback resume state

causes.description: Largest first; absent on attempts submitted before causes existed

LrAnalysis.description: Deterministic review computed at submit (null for older attempts)

other.description: lost-place: the question this answer belongs to

LrCause.description: Lost marks grouped by cause: slip (had the answer, lost the mark), trap (picked a distractor), missed (different detail), blank

audio.description: Asset key; see `assets` for the URL

timings.description: Listening word timings [word, start s, end s]; only after submission

checkEndsAt.description: Listening, before submission: when the checking time the recording announces at its end runs out, in seconds into the last part's audio (word timings). Absent: use 2 minutes after the recording.

LrTest.description: Only the chosen parts; stripped (no answers, no transcript) until submitted

parts.description: Chosen parts (listening 1–4, reading passages 1–3); null = the whole test. Partial attempts are scored raw/total with no band.

trend.description: Last 30 submitted whole-test attempts per skill, oldest first

weakest.description: Up to 3 types with the lowest accuracy (at least 4 questions seen)

suggested.description: A test you have not done with the most questions of your weakest type

causes.description: Lost marks by cause over the last 300 attempts (those analysed with causes), per skill, largest first

score.description: Overall band (speaking/writing), band (L/R); null while pending or partial L/R

replays.description: Replay sessions of that user whose [startedAt-5min, lastAt+5min] covers the attempt time, max 3

since.description: First recorded call; earlier attempts have no cost rows ("not recorded")

okRate.description: 0-1 share of successful calls, last 30 d (all payers)

waste.description: Wasted spend and its share of all spend in the window

perAttempt.description: Finished attempts (status done) that have cost rows, in the window

unrecordedAttempts.description: Finished speaking/writing attempts in the window with no cost rows (ran before tracking started)

warn.description: Recorded house OpenRouter spend and OpenRouter usage_weekly differ by more than 5 percent: some call site is not recorded

recorded.description: false: no cost rows exist (the attempt ran before tracking started); show "not recorded", not $0

sessionTotal.description: Everything recorded for the test session this attempt belongs to

items.description: Costs of the live session itself (realtime model, examiner voice and lines, per-turn transcription), shared by all its parts

transcript.description: The live session's own transcript (GPT-Live sideband or turn-based STT); empty for Gemini Live

burnPerDay7d.description: House OpenRouter spend per day, mean of the last 7 full Dhaka days; null with nothing recorded

avgCostPerTest.description: Mean house cost of a finished speaking/writing attempt, last 30 d

status.description: low < 7 days left, critical < 3, unknown without a burn rate or balance

costUsd.description: null: token-priced model and OpenRouter sent no usage

costExact.description: true: OpenRouter's own usage.cost; false: list price x audio seconds

raw.description: The provider's response as OpenRouter returned it

audio.description: Base64 audio, up to about 22 MB

language.description: ISO code; null lets the model detect it

started.description: You already started a mock on this test

cambridge.description: Complete Cambridge tests; empty unless this account has Cambridge access

own.description: Our own tests can make a complete set

next.description: First section not yet submitted; null once the mock is completed or closed

overall.description: Mean of the four section bands to the nearest 0.5; null until all four exist

attemptId.description: LR attempt, first writing attempt, first speaking attempt (link target)

sessionId.description: Writing / speaking session for the result switcher

limitS.description: Listening 1800 (plus the 2-minute check), reading 3600, writing 3600, speaking none

post.summary: Create an attempt (speaking: returns a presigned audio upload URL)
post.description: Also checks the quota first (nothing is reserved yet), so a person out of tests hears before writing the essay: 429 quota_exceeded, 402 community_balance_exhausted, 503 community_busy. docs/community.md

get.summary: Attempt history, newest first, 20 per page. A guest (anonymous session) gets only their 10 latest, no paging.

post.summary: Submit an attempt for analysis (also re-runs a failed one). Returns immediately; poll GET /api/attempts/{id}.
post.description: Reserves the test against the quota (one per speaking/writing session; re-submitting the same attempt never costs again; refunded if analysis fails or no speech is heard). When refused, a writing draft sent in the body is still saved on the attempt. docs/community.md

get.summary: Lightweight status for polling (no analysis, prompt or presigned URLs); fetch the full attempt when status or stage changes
Attempt with analysis, presigned audio URL and prompt (poll until status is done|failed)

delete.summary: Remove an attempt from my history (any status, also one still in progress)
delete.description: Hard delete: the row, its analysis and mistakes (cascade) and its recording. Review cards stay (they hold no attempt reference). The quota is NOT refunded (quota_usage keeps the payment and its members). A retry whose parent this was loses the parent link.

post.summary: Start a live examiner session: picks a full speaking test and returns the opening line with TTS audio
post.description: Needs the user's own key: OpenRouter for the turn-based examiner (skipTts false), OpenAI or Gemini for duplex sessions (skipTts true), else 403 live_requires_own_key. A user without an OpenRouter key also needs a test left (429 quota_exceeded, 402 community_balance_exhausted).

403.description: live_requires_own_key: the live examiner runs only on the user's own OpenRouter (turn-based), OpenAI (GPT-Live) or Gemini (Gemini Live) key

429.description: Too many requests (too_many_requests), or the test quota is used up (quota_exceeded)

post.summary: Start a full mock test: picks the tests and checks the writing and speaking allowance (reserves nothing)
post.description: One open mock per person: 409 mock_open (with `mockId`) unless `replace=true`, which deletes the open mock row only (its attempts stay). 404 no_complete_set when there is no complete set (also a Cambridge ref this account may not open). Quota errors as for any test: 429, 402, 503.

post.summary: Choose how to do Speaking: recorded test or live examiner
post.description: Needs Writing submitted. recorded: returns the test and the session id (send both `mockId` and `sessionId` with each speaking attempt); the speaking allowance is checked again now. live: needs the person's own key (403 live_requires_own_key); pass `mockId` to /api/live/start, then POST speaking/attach. Switching is allowed until a speaking attempt has been submitted.
